title: FloraProduct
description: Standard schema definition for product objects in the Flora Product Data Intelligence Engine.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product (e.g. P001).

name.description: Full commercial or display name of the product.

subcategory.description: Optional secondary or sub-level product category classification.

specifications.description: Key-value pair map of technical attributes and specifications.

source.description: Metadata regarding the ingestion origin or extraction context of the product.

fileName.description: Name of the source document or payload.

fileType.description: Format/extension of the source payload (e.g. pdf, csv, json, image).

page.description: Page reference or index location within the source document.

extractedBy.description: System, service, or agent that extracted the data (e.g., Gemini-Flash, OCR).
